Practice Task: Analysing a roleplay
Return to Speaking Subtest Main Menu
This task aims to improve your performance in the Speaking Sub-test by raising your awareness what is expected of candidates under the OET Speaking sub-test assessment criteria.
For this task, you should:
1. Open the Speaking Sub-test OET Assessment Criteria (this page will open in a new window) Resize it and leave it on your desktop so you can refer to it while doing the task, OR print the page and refer to it while doing the exercises.
2. When ready, click on the 'Start Task' link below.
3. Excerpt 1 of 8 will display. 
◊ Identify which assessment criteria you think the examiners would view negatively.◊ Use the text box to write your answers.◊ Check your answers using the "Click here to reveal answer" link on the page. ◊ Click 'Next' to go to the next Roleplay excerpt.
START TASK
Next page (after the 8 parts of the practice task)is "Sample Roleplay with assessment"
